bug_info.bug_desc: In the AckWait state, when enable_i is deasserted while waiting for FIFO data, the old code asserted ack_o before transitioning to Idle. This caused the module to acknowledge a request even though no FIFO entry was available and no fifo_pop_o was asserted. The specification requires that disabling the module while waiting cancels the pending request and returns to Idle without acknowledging or popping. This bug could cause a spurious acknowledgement of an empty FIFO, potentially releasing a zero seed.
bug_info.fix_hint: Remove the ack_o = 1'b1 assignment from the !enable_i branch in AckWait. The default value of ack_o is already 1'b0 at the beginning of the combinational block, so the branch should only set state_d to Idle and leave ack_o and fifo_pop_o deasserted.
